bug_fixed.issue: Date comparison for expired campaigns failed silently because close_date (YYYY-MM-DD format) was parsed as naive datetime while now was timezone-aware, causing TypeError in comparison
bug_fixed.fix: Added logic to detect date-only format and append T23:59:59+00:00 to make it timezone-aware and treat as end of day
